title: Studio: controls without an accessible name (records toolbar, flow nodes, sheets, landing cards)
body:
## Source

Read from the accessibility tree on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15, Studio home and the four pillars with HotCRM and a writable package open. Buttons and links whose accessible name is empty:

- Records toolbar (Data pillar, Records tab): Hide fields, Filter, Group, Sort and the "+" that adds a field all read as `button` with no name, although their text is visible. Refresh, Search and Add record have names.
- Flow canvas: the Start and End node buttons (the nodes are buttons) have no name; "Insert node here" and "Add connected node" have one.
- Pending changes sheet (Changes and Publish): the per-item expander and the sheet's close button have no name.
- Access rail: the pinned "Record sharing (OWD)" row is a button with no name.
- Explain access sheet: the User picker (combobox) and the close button have no name.
- Studio home (`BuilderLanding.tsx`): the recently-viewed package links, the "My packages" card, the installed-package cards, the "Organization flows" card and the avatar button in the top bar have no name; the New package dialog's close button has none.
- Data rail object rows read as unnamed buttons in the same tree; Interfaces rows read "object · st_ticket". Verify with the same tool before changing: the row's visible label may already name it and the reading may be the tool's.

## Target

1. Every control above has an accessible name: a visible label names its control (no `aria-hidden` on the only text), icon-only buttons carry `aria-label` with the same words their tooltip shows, cards that act as links or buttons are named by their title.
2. The name is the label the user sees (objectui#11862: label first), never the api name alone.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (toolbar host, flow canvas node buttons if they are rendered here, Changes sheet, Access rail), `StudioRail.tsx`, `StudioInspector.tsx`, `BuilderLanding.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx` (node buttons), `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` if the toolbar buttons are its; tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests query each control by role and name: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Hide fields' })`, `… 'Filter'`, `… 'Group'`, `… 'Sort'`, `… 'Add field'`; `getByRole('button', { name: /Start/ })` on the canvas; `getByRole('button', { name: /close/i })` in the sheet; `getByRole('link', { name: /HotCRM/ })` on the landing.
2. The accessibility tree of each surface, pasted in the PR, shows no unnamed button, link or combobox.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- Visual output unchanged; names only.
- Existing `data-testid`s stay.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

## Evidence

Screenshots from the test pass, kept on the temporary branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `72115588c`, never merged: the maintainer ruled that screenshots do not enter main, and asked for a temporary branch referenced from the card). The branch's `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/README.md` maps every file to its card. Pane captures, 800 × 604 of a 1482 × 1119 viewport, dark unless named light.
